findings.title: Demo no-network lint passes vacuously on the fn-helper path: DEMO_BRANCHED_HELPERS skip + dead demo branches + textual guard matcher
findings.evidence: lint: 'if scope_name.startswith("<fn:") and scope_name[4:-1] in DEMO_BRANCHED_HELPERS: continue' / comment: 'verified by the arm scan like any other scope' / client.gleam save_refcheck_edit: 'case saving.demo_mode {' / Perkins experiment: deleting the skip makes the lint FAIL on client.gleam:7591+7609 (reference_checks_api.correct_reference / substitute_reference, scope <fn:save_refcheck_edit>)
findings.detail: The skip exempts 8 fns from verification while the comment claims arm-scan verification that never runs. save_refcheck_edit's guard is 'saving.demo_mode' — invisible to the matcher (only model.demo_mode/updated_model.demo_mode). The r4-added demo branches in fire_refcheck_slot_action/fire_refcheck_call_action/save_refcheck_edit are DEAD (demo_update.handle intercepts UserChoseRefcheckAction/UserConfirmedRefcheckAction/UserSavedRefcheckEdit first), so the branch defense is illusory; a comment containing 'model.demo_mode' would also satisfy the matcher.
findings.recommended_fix: Match any '*.demo_mode' receiver in demo_guard_in_same_scope; delete the DEMO_BRANCHED_HELPERS skip (or verify those fns' safety via the interception manifest instead); delete the dead demo branches; add a bite-test for helper-scope vacuousness.

findings.title: Advisory test gate: FAIL — the demo entry transition (enter_demo) has zero dispatch-level coverage
findings.location: client/src/client.gleam:488 (routes.Demo,False -> enter_demo), 227 (boot is_demo_route -> enter_demo); client/test/demo/demo_flow_test.gleam:45-58 (demo_entry_shows_dashboard_test hand-builds), 542-557 (deep-link pin hand-builds)
findings.evidence: demo_entry_shows_dashboard_test: 'let m = demo_model()  // hand-built' — no test drives client.update on a non-demo model with BrowserChangedUrl('/demo') or the boot init path; both 'entry' tests start from demo_model()
findings.detail: P0 gap: the feature's front door (landing CTA -> demo; deep-link boot) is unpinned — reverting enter_demo's seeding/auth-swap/NotAsked-reset or its Error arm (route desync, r3 note) stays green. Gate: P0 <100% -> FAIL (narrower than r3's, still failing).
findings.recommended_fix: Add one dispatch test: fresh non-demo model + BrowserChangedUrl(/demo) -> assert demo_mode True, store seeded, auth swapped, dashboard NotAsked->Loading; plus the deep-link boot variant via the init path.

findings.title: still present since round 3: entering demo clobbers a live landlord session (auth + CSRF); exit downgrades auth to NotAsked
findings.location: client/src/client.gleam:5802-5805 (enter_demo overwrites unconditionally); client/src/model.gleam:752 (clear_demo_state auth: NotAsked)
findings.evidence: enter_demo: 'auth: Success(landlord),' overwrites; no stash/restore of the real session anywhere.
findings.detail: Clobbers a logged-in landlord's session; exit loses the real session entirely (no restore).
findings.recommended_fix: Stash the real session on entry and restore it on exit (or block demo entry while authed).

findings.title: still present since round 3: demo exit from a dirty edit page clears demo state BEFORE the unsaved-changes guard fires
findings.evidence: Public-route exit: 'handle_browser_change(model |> model.clear_demo_state, uri, route)' — the guard inside sees cleared state.
findings.detail: Guard evaluates against cleared state — the confirm dialog references data that no longer exists.
findings.recommended_fix: Run the dirty-edit guard before clear_demo_state on demo exits.

findings.title: still present since round 3: vacancy/status mutations return Ok unconditionally — nonexistent ids report success
findings.evidence: '#(DemoStore(..store, vacancies: updated), Ok(vacancy_id))' — no find check; error channel dead.
findings.detail: Error channel is dead; UI reports success for ids that don't exist.
findings.recommended_fix: list.find the vacancy first and propagate Error like update/publish do.

findings.title: still present since round 3: mark_opened doc claims idempotent Submitted->UnderReview but applies to any status
findings.evidence: '/// POST /open - idempotently moves a Submitted application...' then delegates to change_status with no status guard.
findings.detail: Doc/behaviour mismatch; a viewed/rejected app can be 'opened' again.
findings.recommended_fix: Guard on current status == Submitted (no-op otherwise), or fix the doc.

findings.title: still present since round 3: create_vacancy derives ids from an 8-char slug with no uniqueness check
findings.evidence: id_suffix truncates to 8 chars; comment claims 'don't collide' but identical names produce identical ids.
findings.detail: Two 'Test Cottage' creates collide; the second overwrites/shadows the first.
findings.recommended_fix: Check the derived id against the store and append a counter on collision.

findings.title: still present since round 3: send_reminder / remind_applicant / send_bulk_invite mutate nothing and return canned counts
findings.evidence: 'let #(next, result) = demo_store.send_reminder(store, vacancy_id)  let _ = next' — the mutated store is discarded.
findings.detail: Reminders never persist; counts contradict the seeded awaiting list.
findings.recommended_fix: Thread the store back to the model like the other mutations; derive counts from the awaiting pool.

findings.title: still present since round 3 (stronger framing): Declan's household income violates the fixtures module's own stated invariant
findings.evidence: Header: 'household_monthly_income_cents equals primary income + income sources + co-applicants' — Declan: household 650000 vs primary 350000, co_applicant_count 0.

findings.title: NEW: post-exit browser Back to a demo deep link fires a REAL api read with a fixture id — is_demo_route is checked at boot but not in BrowserChangedUrl
findings.evidence: Boot: 'case is_demo_route(route) { True -> enter_demo' vs BrowserChangedUrl: '_, False -> handle_browser_change(model, uri, route)' — /vacancies/v-* after exit goes to the real fetch gate.

findings.recommended_fix: In the BrowserChangedUrl ', False' arm, consult is_demo_route and re-enter the demo (mirroring boot).

findings.title: NEW: ApiReturnedPolicyRefresh lacks the demo guard its exemption comment claims — an in-flight /me overwrites demo auth/csrf

findings.title: NEW: demo ?payment=success / ?extended=success arms discard the accumulated eff — crafted URLs strand the detail skeleton

findings.title: NEW: demo mark-all-read leaves the badge and dropdown stale — no optimistic unread_count, Ok handler is a no-op; the r4 pin is vacuous
findings.location: client/src/demo/demo_update.gleam:560-564; client/src/client.gleam:4393-4410 (real arm), 4468-4470 (Ok no-op); client/src/components/shell.gleam:375-379 (badge reads model.unread_count)
findings.evidence: Demo arm: '#(Model(..model, demo_store: Some(next)), eff)' — no 'unread_count: 0'; ApiReturnedMarkAllRead(Ok(_)) -> #(model, effect.none()); demo_model() starts unread_count 0 so the test's '0' assert never fails.
findings.detail: Badge stays 2 after mark-all-read until a refetch; store-level pin passes vacuously.
findings.recommended_fix: Mirror the real arm's optimistic update (unread_count: 0 + notifications map) in the demo dispatch; fix the pin to start from unread_count 2.

findings.title: NEW: Grace's baked PDF flag is arithmetically wrong — 'Income covers only 58%' when income/rent = 98%

findings.title: NEW: three r4-fixed store behaviours are unpinned (revert-green) — scoring in_progress=pending, remindable/followup derivation
